situation (example wording): A national or state Historical scorecard shows a Violent Crime or Property Crime group rate, for example the national property rate for 2025.
what the app does today: The group rate was the sum of the three or four already-rounded component rates, so the national 2025 property rate showed 1,534.7 (193.6 + 1,144.1 + 197.0) while the published Crime Index figure is 1,534.8.
proposed behavior: A group rate is the summed offense count over the population per 100,000, rounded once, which matches the published figure (national 2025 property 1,534.8, violent 327.6). Component rows are unchanged.
why: Coordinator decision 2026-11-24: the scorecard must show the published Crime Index figure.
